name: patentmcp
description: Patent-data MCP server — USPTO / Google Patents (BigQuery) / TIPO GPSS / EPO OPS. Search, retrieve, screen and stage prior-art artifacts. Runs as an isolated Docker container; transfers files via token-based download over a Unix socket.
instructions:
Pair with the **patentworks** skill (bundled via skillPaths; downloadable at /patentmcp/skills/patentworks.zip). It is the playbook for these tools — disclosure -> screening -> drafting, plus per-jurisdiction drafting rules — so load it before any patent search or drafting task.

patentmcp produced files are reachable on this host via:
  curl --unix-socket /home/pkcs12/projects/patentmcp/.run/patentmcp.sock http://patentmcp.local/files/{token}/blob/{rel}
(The {token} and {rel} placeholders come from each tool result's handle.)

The human landing page (install guide + live tool list + patentworks skill download) is served at GET / on the same socket, and through the gateway at /patentmcp. The skill zip is at /patentmcp/skills/patentworks.zip.

Introspection & lifecycle: GET /tools returns machine-readable tool schemas from the live FastMCP registry (JSON {tools:[{name,description,inputSchema}]}); GET /health (and back-compat alias /healthz) returns liveness ({ok,service,store}). Host-side recovery: scripts/patentmcp-self-heal.sh {--check|--heal} probes the UDS socket and recreates only the patentmcp-${USER} compose project when unhealthy (never spawns a competing daemon).

Search: `patent_search` is the SINGLE search entry point. The source ladder is built into the server — TIPO GPSS (official, primary) > EPO OPS > USPTO PPUBS > (gated) Google Patents scraper — you do not pick a source; the server routes by credential availability and query-axis capability, and every level's attempt is recorded in the result's `provenance` array. The scraper tail only runs with allow_scraping=true (explicit user authorization); otherwise all-official-miss fails fast with error_code=SCRAPING_REQUIRED. Retired tools (gpss_search / epo_search / gpatents_search / uspto_patents ppubs_search_*) are gone — call patent_search instead. Single-document fetch tools (epo_family / epo_biblio / gpatents_get / uspto_patents full-document methods / ppubs_batch_get_claims) remain available.
